description:
Real-world usage: tldr-pages examples for Bash's builtins and compound commands.

Source: tldr-pages (https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr, CC BY 4.0), pages/common and pages/linux
at commit 8cf22035e60b167ebf224c1c527b27e0b5dca24d; see ../NOTICE. Each example runs with its
placeholders bound, then over the values it meets in practice (empty, unset, spaces, globs,
numbers that are not numbers, missing files). Examples that need a terminal, a login shell,
history, job control, other users, or print the whole environment are left out, as are the
builtins the tool refuses (umask, ulimit, `enable -n`, `exec -a/-c/-l`, bg, fg, fc, coproc).

mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
mkdir d && : >f
if [[ -f d ]]; then echo "Condition is true"; fi; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: real tldr if: check -d on d
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
mkdir d && : >f
if [[ -d d ]]; then echo "Condition is true"; fi; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: real tldr if: check -e on f

cases.name: real tldr if: check -e on nope
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
mkdir d && : >f
if [[ -e nope ]]; then echo "Condition is true"; fi; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: real tldr if: a variable is defined
cases.script:
variable=x
if [[ -n "$variable" ]]; then echo "Condition is true"; fi

cases.name: real tldr if: a variable is not defined
cases.script: if [[ -n "$variable" ]]; then echo "Condition is true"; else echo no; fi

cases.name: real tldr if: elif chain
cases.script: n=2; if [ $n = 1 ]; then echo one; elif [ $n = 2 ]; then echo two; else echo other; fi

cases.name: real tldr if: status when no branch runs
real tldr if: command list as condition
cases.script: if false; true; then echo last-wins; fi

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate command line parameters
cases.script: set -- a 'b c' d; for variable; do echo $variable; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate items
cases.script: for variable in item1 "item 2" item3; do echo "Loop is executed: $variable"; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate an empty list
cases.script: for variable in; do echo never; done; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate a range
cases.script: for variable in {1..10..3}; do echo "Loop is executed $variable"; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate a descending range
cases.script: for variable in {5..1..2}; do echo $variable; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate a letter range
cases.script: for variable in {a..e}; do printf $variable; done; echo

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate a zero-padded range
cases.script: for variable in {08..11}; do echo $variable; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate files
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
: >file1 && : >'file 2'
for variable in file1 'file 2' nope; do [ -e "$variable" ] && echo "exists: $variable" || echo "missing: $variable"; done

cases.name: real tldr for: iterate directories
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
mkdir dir1 dir2
for variable in dir1/ dir2/; do echo "Loop is executed $variable"; done

cases.name: real tldr for: every directory
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
mkdir -p d1 d2 && : >d1/x && : >notadir
for variable in */; do (cd "$variable" || continue; echo "in $variable: $(ls)") done

cases.name: real tldr for: every directory when there are none
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
for variable in */; do echo "[$variable]"; done

cases.name: real tldr for: arithmetic for
cases.script: for ((i = 0; i < 3; i++)); do echo $i; done

cases.name: real tldr for: glob with no match
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
for f in *.nope; do echo "[$f]"; done

cases.name: real tldr while: read stdin
cases.script: printf 'l1\nl2\n' | while read line; do echo "$line"; done

cases.name: real tldr while: read stdin with backslashes and spaces
cases.script: printf '  a\\b  \n' | while read line; do echo "[$line]"; done

cases.name: real tldr while: a command forever with a break
cases.script: n=0; while :; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -ge 3 ] && break; sleep 0.01; done; echo $n

cases.name: real tldr while: until a command fails
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
printf '3' >n
while [ "$(cat n)" -gt 0 ]; do v=$(cat n); echo $v; echo $((v-1)) >n; done

cases.name: real tldr while: reading a file with redirection
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
printf 'a\nb\n' >f
while IFS= read -r l; do echo "<$l>"; done < f

cases.name: real tldr until: until a command succeeds
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
n=0; until [ -e ready ]; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -eq 3 ] && : >ready; done; echo $n

cases.name: real tldr until: status of an until loop
real tldr until: waiting with a sleep
cases.script: i=0; until [ $i -ge 2 ]; do echo "Waiting..."; i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.01; done; echo "Launched!"

printf 'one two\nthree\n' >README
COUNTRULE='words'
case $COUNTRULE in words) wc --words README ;; lines) wc --lines README ;; esac; echo "status=$?"

cases.script: select word in apple orange pear banana; do echo "[$word] [$REPLY]"; break; done <<< '9'

cases.script: select word in apple orange pear banana; do echo "[$word] [$REPLY]"; break; done <<< ''

: >a && : >b
